title: Amtrak named-asset reliability hold: complaint processes remain aggregate
summary: Amtrak describes continuous audits, defect remediation, complaint resolution, and stakeholder meetings but does not link outcomes to named stations, PIDS devices, bridge plates, ramps, or induction loops. Denominator: The exact named accessibility assets in the Phase 57D cohorts, requiring asset-period uptime, outage, maintenance, actual-use, complaint, resolution, boarding-time, and rider-experience fields.
key_findings: Finding: Amtrak describes continuous audits, defect remediation, complaint resolution, and stakeholder meetings but does not link outcomes to named stations, PIDS devices, bridge plates, ramps, or induction loops.

Next action: Reopen with stable asset identifiers and compatible asset-period reliability, use, complaint, and rider-outcome tables.
